title: Machine Learning A-Z
wikitext:
== Course Overview ==
'''Machine Learning A-Z''' is an advanced comprehensive course covering supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms.

== Instructor ==
[[Dr. James Liu]]

== Course Details ==
| Level | Advanced |
| Duration | 18 hours |
| Lessons | 55 |
| Price | $149 |
| Rating | 4.9/5 (3,156 reviews)

== What You'll Learn ==
* Regression and classification
* Neural networks and deep learning
* Clustering and dimensionality reduction
* Model evaluation and optimization

== Prerequisites ==
Python for Data Science or equivalent knowledge required.
